Talent0_2Ability.name: Valkyrie
Talent0_2Ability.SpecificEffects: Can gain up to <color=#F74848>5</color> levels of the <buf ID=900120>[Awakening]</buf> status. At level <color=#F74848>5</color>, <buf ID=900118>[Valhalla's Call]</buf> activates, lasting for <color=#F74848>2</color> turns. When actively attacking, if a part is destroyed or a target is defeated, increases <buf ID=900120>[Awakening]</buf> by <color=#F74848>1</color> level. These trigger conditions can activate <color=#F74848>1</color> time each per turn.

Talent3_5Ability.name: Valkyrie
Talent3_5Ability.SpecificEffects:
Can gain up to <color=#F74848>5</color> levels of the <buf ID=900120>[Awakening]</buf> status. At level <color=#F74848>5</color>, <buf ID=900118>[Valhalla's Call]</buf> activates, lasting for <color=#F74848>2</color> turns. When actively attacking, if a part is destroyed or a target is defeated, increases <buf ID=900120>[Awakening]</buf> by <color=#F74848>1</color> level. These trigger conditions can activate <color=#F74848>1</color> time each per turn.
Upon deployment, activates <buf ID=900118>[Valhalla's Call]</buf>.
When <buf ID=900118>[Valhalla's Call]</buf> ends, retains an additional <color=#F74848>1</color> level of <buf ID=900120>[Awakening]</buf>.

400001.name: Strategic Bombing 1
400001.SpecificEffects: When a Tactical Weapon runs out of ammo, trigger <buf ID=900029>[Auto Load]</buf>. This process takes <color=#F74848>3</color> turns.

400909.name: Ballistic Bundle
400909.describe: Uses a Machine Gun to attack a target, dealing <color=#F74848>1.3</color>x DMG.

400902.name: Ultimate Mastery
400902.SpecificEffects: When HP is above <color=#F74848>50%</color>, DMG <color=#F74848>+15%</color> and DMG Taken <color=#F74848>-10%</color>.

400903.name: Waking Dream
400903.describe: Fully reloads all Cutter Ammo and gains <buf ID=7100503>[Crit DMG UP II]</buf> for <color=#F74848>1</color> turn. Can continue action with remaining Movement.

400904.name: Bullet Storm
400904.describe:
Simultaneously uses two Machine Guns to attack a target, dealing <color=#F74848>0.75</color>x DMG <color=#F74848>2</color> times, and increases <buf ID=900120>[Awakening]</buf> by <color=#F74848>1</color> level.
When in <buf ID=900118>[Valhalla's Call]</buf> Mode, simultaneously uses two Machine Guns to attack a target, dealing <color=#F74848>0.75</color>x DMG <color=#F74848>2</color> times. Before combat, gains <buf ID=7100104>[Hit Rate UP II]</buf> and <buf ID=7100404>[Crit Rate UP II]</buf>, lasting for <color=#F74848>2</color> turns.

400905.name: No-Fly Order
400905.SpecificEffects: Automatically uses Cutter to intercept incoming rockets within range, shooting them all down. Can only trigger <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn.

400906.name: Solo Breakthrough
400906.describe:
Uses a Cutter to attack all targets within <color=#F74848>3</color> tiles, dealing <color=#F74848>1.1</color>x AoE DMG and increasing <buf ID=900120>[Awakening]</buf> by <color=#F74848>1</color> level. After combat, restores HP equal to <color=#F74848>40%</color> of damage dealt to undestroyed parts.
When in <buf ID=900118>[Valhalla's Call]</buf> Mode, the Repair AMT applied to undestroyed parts after combat is increased to <color=#F74848>50%</color>.

400907.name: Overcapacity Firepower
400907.SpecificEffects: When engaging in a <buf ID=900002>[Link Attack]</buf> or <buf ID=900061>[Link Retaliation]</buf>, DMG <color=#F74848>+20%</color>. If this <buf ID=900002>[Link Attack]</buf> or <buf ID=900061>[Link Retaliation]</buf> destroys a part, it does not consume a Link chance.

400908.name: Fate's Verdict
400908.describe:
Simultaneously uses two Machine Guns to attack a target, dealing <color=#F74848>0.85</color>x DMG <color=#F74848>2</color> times, and increases <buf ID=900120>[Awakening]</buf> by <color=#F74848>2</color> levels.
When in <buf ID=900118>[Valhalla's Call]</buf> Mode, simultaneously uses two Machine Guns and Cutter to attack a target. The Machine Guns deal <color=#F74848>0.85</color>x DMG <color=#F74848>2</color> times, and the Cutter consumes <color=#F74848>2</color> Ammo to deal <color=#F74848>0.3</color>x DMG <color=#F74848>4</color> times. If the target is destroyed, refunds <color=#F74848>2</color> AP and <color=#F74848>1</color> Cutter Ammo.

400931.name: Final Prototype 1
400931.SpecificEffects: Assault Weapons and Cutters can launch a <buf ID=900002>[Link Attack]</buf>, dealing <color=#F74848>0.2</color>x and <color=#F74848>0.4</color>x DMG respectively. Each can trigger up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn. If the target is within range of both Cutter and Assault Weapon, Assault Weapon is used first.

200033.name: Adaptive Warfare 1
200033.SpecificEffects: At the end of the action, if an Active Attack was not initiated this turn, an extra <color=#F74848>2</color> tiles can be moved.

400934.name: Final Prototype 2
400934.SpecificEffects: Cutter <buf ID=900002>[Link Attack]</buf> Count <color=#F74848>+1</color>. Damage multiplier is increased to <color=#F74848>0.5</color>x.

400935.name: Final Prototype 3
400935.SpecificEffects: When any ally is attacked and drawn into combat, if the attacker is within the Cutter's attack range, uses Cutter to launch a <buf ID=900061>[Link Retaliation]</buf>, dealing <color=#F74848>0.5</color>x DMG. Can trigger up to <color=#F74848>2</color> times per turn.

400936.name: Final Prototype 4
400936.SpecificEffects: While in <buf ID=900118>[Valhalla's Call]</buf> Mode, can use <color=#F74848>2</color> Cutters to launch <buf ID=900002>[Link Attack]</buf> and <buf ID=900061>[Link Retaliation]</buf>, dealing <color=#F74848>2×0.5</color>x DMG.

400941.name: Battlefield Dominion 1
400941.SpecificEffects: When <buf ID=900118>[Valhalla's Call]</buf> ends, <color=#F74848>1</color> level of <buf ID=900120>[Awakening]</buf> will be retained.

200043.name: Adaptive Warfare 2
200043.SpecificEffects:
If not moved before an Active Attack, <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> can be triggered, effective up to <color=#F74848>1</color> time per turn. Unable to move before attacking.
Effects similar to <buf ID=900004>[Re-ATK]</buf> cannot be re-triggered.

400944.name: Battlefield Dominion 2
400944.SpecificEffects: At the end of action, immediately loads <color=#F74848>1</color> Cutter Ammo.

400945.name: Battlefield Dominion 3
400945.SpecificEffects: When attacking with a Cutter, for every <color=#F74848>1</color> target hit, this attack's DMG <color=#F74848>+5%</color>, up to <color=#F74848>+20%</color>.

400946.name: Battlefield Dominion 4
400946.SpecificEffects: When in <buf ID=900118>[Valhalla's Call]</buf> Mode, after an active attack, uses a Cutter to deal <color=#F74848>0.6</color>x AoE DMG to up to <color=#F74848>3</color> targets within attack range.
